title: Researchers found 768 leaked AWS keys that still work, and the containment policy leaves plenty possible
summary: Truffle Security found 768 leaked AWS keys granting full control of corporate accounts, including 526 root keys, with 88% of tested credentials still active. Researchers have found 768 leaked Amazon Web Services keys that still give full control of a company’s account.
